senses.gloss: m. (ὀξύγαρον, oxygarum) a sauce of vinegar and garum; in gen. a sauce of all kinds of vegetables.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 35b:13">Ber. 35ᵇ</cite> bot. Ms. M. (ed. <he>אנס׳</he>); <cite ref="Yoma 76a:9">Yoma 76ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 23a:2">Shebu. 23ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:16">Tosef. Bets. II, 16</cite>. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ top <he>אָקְסִי׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 9:10">Tosef. Ter. IX, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 9:10">ib.</cite>
Shebi. VI, 3 סְנִיגְרוֹן.—Pl. אָכְסִיגָרִיּוֹת, abbrev. סִגָּרִיּוֹת vegetable sauces, vegetables used for oxygarum.
